description: Submit a consolidated rate & availability request for up to 3 shortlisted Gauteng venues. Alerts the venue coordinators directly via email/WhatsApp, creates an escrow quote review session, and returns the actionable client review URL (https://arranged.co.za/quotes?token=...).

clientEmail.description: The client's email address to receive quote updates

clientPhone.description: The client's South African contact phone / WhatsApp number

dateFlexible.description: Whether the event date is flexible (defaults to true)

eventDate.description: Estimated or preferred event date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if flexible

venueIds.description: Array of 1 to 3 venue IDs shortlisted by the client (e.g., ['ven_1', 'ven_2', 'ven_3'])

name: request_curated_quotes
